description: This file defines the 'Rates' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically providing financial functions related to security rates such as discount rates and interest rates. It includes methods for calculating discount and interest based on security and date parameters, utilizing validation and date calculation helpers.

classes.name: Rates
classes.description: A class providing financial calculations related to securities, such as discount and interest rate calculations, using various validation and date functions.

methods.name: discount
methods.description: Calculates the discount rate for a security based on settlement date, maturity date, price, redemption value, and basis.

methods.name: interest
methods.description: Calculates the interest rate for a fully invested security based on settlement date, maturity date, investment amount, redemption amount, and basis.
